startup.choiceBody: Choose whether to continue with this Study Coach instance or clear its learning data and start fresh.
startup.inspectionErrorTitle: Local data could not be inspected
startup.inspectionErrorBody: Retry the inspection, or continue without clearing if you understand that existing data may remain.
startup.externalTitle: Learning data changed in another tab
startup.externalBody: Another tab cleared this instance's learning data. Refresh local state before continuing.

reset.learningBody: Clear learning data deletes imported document records and embeddings, Chat history, Quiz and review data, goals, plans, milestones, mistakes, mastery, and current in-memory learning state. Model, provider, API, language, and interface settings remain.
reset.factoryTitle: Factory reset this Study Coach instance?
reset.factoryBody: Factory reset deletes all learning data, local model and interface settings, cached model capability, local identity, and backend local user rows. This cannot be undone.
reset.counts: Currently stored: {documents} documents, {chunks} source chunks, and {vectors} embeddings.
reset.resettingBody: Keep Study Coach open while local data is being cleared.

toast.learningCleared: Learning data cleared. {count} stored records and vectors deleted.
